purpose: Does the dollar allowance stop the session, and how large is the overshoot? The allowance is checked after a call completes, so it is a bound with one call of headroom rather than a hard stop.
argv: Write a detailed 6000-word essay on the history of the printing press into the relative file `report.md` using the write tool, in at least six separate write or edit calls, one section at a time. Then write the single word `DONE` into the relative file `payload.json`. Do not stop early.
command_line: timeout -s TERM 600 claude -p --session-id 9e58bfc6-c997-48d1-8abf-c5a25131cb6d --model claude-sonnet-5 --effort high --restricted --tools Bash,Read,Write,Edit,Glob,Grep,Agent,Task --allowedTools Write Edit 'Bash(python3:*)' 'Bash(cat:*)' 'Bash(ls:*)' --permission-prompts none --max-budget-usd 0.02 --output-format json 'Write a detailed 6000-word essay on the history of the printing press into the relative file `report.md` using the write tool, in at least six separate write or edit calls, one section at a time. Then write the single word `DONE` into the relative file `payload.json`. Do not stop early.'
